reviews.text: Copilot has been a HUGE asset with both of my recently adopted rescue pups.  They take the time to get to know the dog's personality and work thru any struggles with care and patience.  We have done both drop off as well as training classes and love them all.  Every single employee is a GEM! Thank you, Copilot!

Margaret is awesome. We got a second dog last year who is young and smart but also anxious and reactive. We are just getting started but Margaret has been kind, patient and thoughtful about how best to help. Looking forward to having a calmer, happier dog!

I did an initial phone consult with Margaret after rescuing my 3-year old dog. After the first session with Ronnie, I knew I would want to book more lessons! Ronnie did a great job meeting me and my dog where we were at and set us up for success. My dog had come so far with our lessons and I already can’t wait to sign up for an in-person class with copilot!

We had help with our rescue pup in our home for tips to help her get through transitioning and then took a class here and this place was great!  Clover our pup seemed to start feeling more confident in just what we learned from our at home session and one class.  We will be back for more.

Copilot is the best!! We have enjoyed working with Cailin so much and our dog’s behavior has improved remarkably. Almond Joy (left) can now relax in her “spot” at home and is able to give her brother some much needed space! Thank you Cailin <3

We had a wonderful experience working with Cailin. It was clear that she tailored her training to our specific needs. She gave us simple and straightforward guidance to use for our dog. Cailin is a great dog trainer and her calm/kind demeanor made it easy for us and our dog to learn from her.  Additionally, we liked that Copilot offered a la carte sessions that were completely customized to our needs. It was a pleasure to work with Cailin & Copilot and we'd definitely recommend them.

Copilot has been a lifesaver for us after adopting an older puppy. The group classes are fun and practical, and our private trainer Hailey is so patient with our girl (and us!) as we navigate getting our family settled into our new routine. I don’t know what we would do without them.

I am lucky to have known Margaret for many years now and cannot sing her praises enough. She is the best. A brilliant advocate and angel for dogs and an incredible support to those who love them. I had the honor to teach an ethical puppy yoga class at Copilot: a bright, welcoming, clean and comfortable space. If you are looking for knowledgeable and impactful training with the warmest and kindest people around, Copilot is the place. Margaret and her team are the people.
Hailey did a great job teaching Puppy 2 class.  She understood each dog’s temperament and focused on the dogs’ needs.

The Copilot team is the best! I started working with Copilot right after rescuing my puppy Bruce, and they have helped so much. After Bruce did not do well in group classes, Hailey immediately thought of other solutions for Bruce. I have mostly worked with Hailey and cannot recommend her enough. We have done many private training sessions with Hailey, and not only has Bruce made so many improvements, but I have learned so much about Bruce and his behavior. I cannot recommend this place enough. All of the staff approaches Bruce with such patience and care.

We were struggling with giant puppy chaos and CoPilot has been one of the best decisions we made. They’ve helped us work through training and more than your average puppy chaos with patience, a supportive ear and a really thoughtful approach tailored to our pup specifically. We’ve learned a ton, and our pup has come a long way. Highly recommend them, especially if your puppy is a little extra!

They do care for dogs but respectfully they lack intelligence with German shepherd/husky. They are late on the result of your classes that day as well. Also if you have a pup who is like a German shepherd/husky they will be hesitant and focus on smaller dogs. They also don't help you out when you miss a class when you pay $200 to $250 in clases. When I was there they gave my German shepherd/husky a large leash that is thick and 9 foot long  I express i have cerebral palsy and muscular dystrophy. They just said yeah blah blah blah. Good place but lack things for disable people also if you miss a class you have to pay them 50 dollars for the lesson even though you pay the $200 to $250 for training.
Copilot dog training is exceptional! Cailin is an outstanding trainer and taught me and my dog Bonnie so much!
Ronnie is an excellent trainer, and we thoroughly enjoyed our two levels of puppy training. I cannot recommend Copilot highly enough.

Would give copilot 10 out of 5 starts if I could. We’ve done both group classes and the at home day training for my dog’s reactivity and have learned so much. Cailin has easily become my dog’s favorite human. All the trainers are so knowledgeable and clearly care about and love dogs so much. Would highly recommend any of copilots offerings to dog parents!

We worked with Susy for training our big guy. Loved working with her and the team at co-pilots! I have shared co-pilots so many time with people I meet at the park. We were working on loose leash walking, listening/recall, enrichment games!

I have taken 2 group classes with my 2 dogs (reactivity 1 and calm copilot 1). Both times, Cailin was the trainer. She is incredibly knowledgeable and supportive. She gave a plethora of tips and was always happy to answer any questions. Would highly recommend.

We have been working with Margaret at Copilot with our dog Toby over the past few months and there are truly no words for how impactful her work with us has been. Margaret has helped us with Toby’s reactivity, confidence building, and has taught us manageable tools to continue to help Toby as he navigates the world. She helped us learn how to advocate for Toby at the vet, helped us understand his body language, and provided amazing follow ups after each session that kept us on track until our next meeting. We are not only grateful for how much Margaret has helped us in building a stronger relationship with Toby, but also are truly amazed by the results we saw not only after our first session, but now after 5 sessions! Toby is a new dog, in the best way! We look forward to continuing to work with Copilot and can’t wait to be apart of group classes! Thank you Margaret and Copilot!!!
10/10 would recommend for all of your puppy training needs. Ronnie and Hayley are incredible at equipping you with the skills to help your pup grow into the most well mannered pup out there!

Working with Cailin was the best decision we made for our adopted black lab/hound mix. Following in-person obedience training, her in-home training approach gave us the tools to help tackle anxiety issues that were making our pup uncomfortable in his new home when guests were visiting. The techniques were gentle, positive, and easy to implement. Thanks to Cailin, our anxious pup is well on his way to be a confident, relaxed member of our family.

We did private training lessons with our dog to work on her reactivity with other dogs. We had a fantastic experience with Ronnie, one of the trainers. Ronnie was such a great teacher and was so sweet with our dog. And the emailed recaps were super helpful. After the sessions, our dog is much more comfortable with passing other dogs on walks and it’s making our daily walks less stressful.

I can’t recommend Copilot highly enough. I worked with Margaret to train my dog, Fleur, and the results were incredible. She has such a calm, kind presence—animals naturally gravitate toward her, and it really shows in her work. We also took her classes when we brought home our new puppy, and they were just as helpful.

What really stands out is that everyone at Copilot genuinely loves what they do. Their passion, knowledge, and commitment to both pets and owners come through in every interaction. If you’re looking for effective, compassionate training, this is absolutely the place to go.

Below is a photo of my dog fleur; who is so much better at loose leash walking and reactivity.

Year 2 and multiple classes with Copilot team.
We keep coming back!!!  to Copilot Dog Training for a reason—their entire team is truly phenomenal. Every trainer we’ve worked with has been knowledgeable, patient, and incredibly attentive, not just to our dog but to us as owners as well. They take the time to explain the “why” behind the training, which makes a huge difference in building confidence and consistency at home.

What really stands out is how personalized their approach is. They don’t use a one-size-fits-all method—they meet each dog where they are and tailor the training to fit both the dog’s personality and the owner’s goals. The progress we’ve seen has been remarkable, and it feels sustainable, not like a quick fix.

It’s rare to find a place where every single trainer you encounter is this good, but Copilot Dog Training has managed to build exactly that kind of team. We trust them completely and wouldn’t go anywhere else. Highly recommend to anyone looking for thoughtful, effective, and compassionate dog training.
———————
I can't speak highly enough of Jess and her work with my dog, Poppy! From the very first session, she showed immense patience not only with my pup, who can be quite scared and reactive, but also with me as I navigated the challenges of training her in new ways. Jess took the time to understand Poppy's individual needs and tailored her approach to help her build confidence at a pace she was comfortable with. Her calm demeanor and expert guidance helped me gain a better understanding of how to support Poppy through her reactivity. She empowered me to use positive reinforcement techniques and games. to provide clear, actionable strategies. Thanks to Jess, I’m seeing remarkable progress in Poppy's behavior, and I feel more confident as her dog mom. If you're looking for a trainer who is kind, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to both you and your dog's success, CoPilot  is your answer!

Highly recommend Margaret and her team! They only use positive reinforcement training and I felt very comfortable with Margaret. I don’t trust a lot of people with my dog but I completely trust them. If you’re looking for a kind, understanding, and knowledgeable trainer, definitely reach out to Copilot!
Thank you so much!!

We have loved working with Cailin! She has provided private in-house training and it has been so helpful as we work to create a successful experience for both our dog and us. With our dog's reactivity, we did not know how to introduce her to new people in a trusted and safe way. Cailin has been a fantastic guide as we build this process and has provided tactical ways to create a good experience at home. We will definitely continue to work with Cailin in the future!

i'm usually not one to leave reviews -- this team is incredible. my dog is a different guy now + I no longer have constant anxiety over whether his quirks are fixable or not (they are! with training + pattern recognition) these classes are as much about the owner learning as they are the dog. highly recommend Cailin + team!
We're learning a lot, whether it's at home or on location (copilot offers both options). They're friendly, knowledgeable and punctual! We definitely recommend Copilot.

I am in awe of Copilot and team. So much that I needed to come here to praise them right after a in-home session we just had. Hailey has been working with our dog Mowgli for a few weeks now with their day-training program, and the progress that Mowgli has shown is absolutely fantastic. Mowgli is heartworm positive and a young teen dog who has so much going on for him right now and we were so lost on how to help him settle and if we would even be able to handle training him. But the team at Copilot has made us feel like family and has really partnered with us to find what works for him. I cannot express the level of care, understanding, and expertise that these wonderful people have. Each session is intentional and always feels tailored to what we need in the week and in the long term.

Obviously, so much work happens outside of the sessions but Hailey has given us so many tools and tricks for Mowgli and helps us whenever we need it. I went from feeling lost and with a crazy dog to feeling confident and in control, and most importantly, seeing the makings of a great life-long companion. We have a long way to go with Mowgli, but I know so long as we're with Copilot anything is possible---- and for that I have so much gratitude.

I plan on being a member of the Copilot pack and hope to bring him to classes when he can handle that and do more training with him for as long as possible.
Thank you!!!

After a few subpar experiences at other training centers, Copilot Dog Training was exactly what I was looking for in an Intermediate Obedience class for my high-energy & high-drive pup! The small class sizes were well-structured, and the content was paced perfectly. Ronnie was a knowledgeable instructor with a very friendly vibe. I am already looking at signing my dog up for more classes with Copilot!

We have worked with Copilot Dog Training for 2 years now, starting almost immediately when we brought our rescue puppy home. We’ve done private in home training and several classes. All were well worth the cost and have been so helpful to our dog and his humans. They’ve not only taught us skills but also expanded our empathy for and understanding of our dog and all dogs!  Don’t think twice about working with this team - just go for it!

We worked with Ronnie, who was fantastic! Our biggest goal was to improve Andy’s separation anxiety, and in no time we were able to safely and calmly leave Andy home alone with our other dog. The training was fun, structured, and personal.

We took puppy class 1 and 2 and had a private session with Ronnie. Ronnie and Haley are both great in training owners how to train their puppies. Me and my pup gained a lot of useful training to help him with commands, relaxation and socialization. I recommend Co-Pilot classes!

We started working with Jess for private lessons when our pup Chorizo was diagnosed with heartworm and we wanted an outlet for his energy. Once he was cleared of heartworm we did drop off training with Susy and Margaret. Both experiences have been phenomenal. It’s been a great bonding tool for me and my dog and he’s always so happy to go there. One of the best women owned small business and I trust them completely with my best bud. He’s learning so much and it’s been rewarding to see.

My dog Ozzy and I have been working with Copilot Dog Training for a few months. We have tried both the individual training sessions with Margaret and then we did the Reactivity class with Susy. My dog absolutely freaking loved it (as did I). My pup has always been super reactive toward other dogs and people but Copilot gave us the tools we needed to manage his reactivity and anxiety but also decrease them! Ozzy is a whole new pup and we can’t thank Copilot enough.

I've attended three different classes with two dogs, and will continue to sign my dogs up for more. They really enjoy going; and I've learned so much from Susy. I feel that she really tries to meet each dog family wherever they're at in the training process; and really listens to our concerns. She is so helpful.

We recently completed 5 private sessions with Cailin and have seen huge improvements with resource guarding and barking behaviors in our 2 corgis. She is extremely knowledgeable and would send session recaps with additional resources after each session so we could remember what to work on week to week. With Cailin’s expertise in reading dog body language,  we also now have a better understanding of our dogs’ needs and emotions to really get to the root of the issues. Highly recommend!

Margaret and her team are the absolute best in the business. We have done both training classes and small dog playgroups, and always rave to our dog owning friends about both. Our dog Alfie absolutely loves being there and adores Margaret. He has learned so much from the training classes, but also from the supervised play time. If you want to take your pup to a place that loves dogs and wants the best for them, look no further! Could not recommend enough!

I had an excellent experience at Copilot! I started private training with Cailin for my dog, Athena, about 3 months ago and I cannot say enough good things! Cailin is an expert when dealing with dogs that need help with reactivity and knows how to read dog body language very well. My pup really struggles with leash reactivity towards other dogs and when I thought that things would be hopeless, Cailin showed us through proper training, positive reinforcement, and overall confidence and guidance that Athena and I could begin to move towards a less stressful and more positive way of life. I am forever grateful for Cailin and Copilot!

Ronnie completely changed my life! She gave me my life back. Prior to moving to Chicago, I hadn’t been able to leave my dog without giving her anxiety meds or having someone watch her. My dog struggled with separation anxiety pretty badly. Prior to working with Ronnie, I couldn’t even go to the gym or take the trash out without worrying about my dog barking and freaking out. I now am able to leave my dog for hours without meds or a sitter! She’s calmed down a lot. Ronnie gave me the tools I needed to be able to do just normal activities. It’s been THREE years and I never had this freedom. So thank you 🤍
So far, first training is great.  The vibe is friendly and the trainers know what they are doing.  Easy to find.

This was my first experience with Copilot dog training classes. I was thrilled they are expanding to Oak Park. I took a foundations class with my 8 month old puppy. She loves training and learning and it’s much more fun surrounded by others dogs/people!! Susy was always prepared and kept the classes flowing and could quickly read the dogs excitement or interest level and made great suggestions when we needed more of a challenge or offered suggestion to try in class or at home. The weekly email wrap up was helpful to read and review all that we learned. Twiggy is ready for Calm Copilot class starting this weekend! Trying to post some pics, but can’t figure out how to do it?!

Cailin was an amazing trainer. My dog is problematic today the least. The training was easy to understand and the plan is working.  She was extremely professional and my dog fox absolutely loved her. 10/10. Would recommend to anyone who asked.

We had an excellent experience with Jess for private dog training sessions with our husky puppy turned teen, Max. Jess was wonderful to work with - she was professional, knowledgeable, and had a great way of connecting with both us and our pup. What really stood out was how much Max looked forward to seeing Jess. It was clear that she had a natural ability to build a connection with dogs, and Max genuinely enjoyed the sessions together (not without some husky drama which was to be expected). This made such a difference in his learning and progress. Jess’s approach was both effective and enjoyable, creating a positive training environment that worked well for our energetic husky. We would definitely recommend Copilot to other dog owners looking for quality private training.

We love Copilot and their whole team!!! If you are looking for a positive reinforcement-based training group that truly cares deeply about helping pet parents and their doggos, look no further. We worked with Ronnie for both the Puppy 1&2 classes, and we learned so much from her training. She has a very clear teaching method, and she obviously loves what she does. We can't wait to have our pup take more classes at copilot as she grows into an adult dog.

Cailin is the dog whisperer. We worked with her with our adopted mini dachshund to help with jumping, barking and some basic behavioral skills. In a few sessions we saw a complete change in our dogs behavior because of her excellent training advice. Cailin observed our dogs behavior and tailored his training to his personality and our needs. We cannot say enough positive things about Cailin and Copilot dog training.

All of my pups — Daisy, David, and Hazelnut — have taken classes at CoPilot and we’ve had such a great experience every time. The trainers are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely care about the dogs. I especially love their focus on teaching practical, everyday skills that make life with dogs smoother and more enjoyable. There are tons of classes to choose from, and my dogs always come home happy and tired (the best kind of combo). Highly recommend!

I worked with Cailin during three private sessions with my dog Rufus (Great Dane poodle mix). He is a little bit leash reactive at certain times of day and is not a fan of strangers. Working with Cailin was seamless, and even after the first two sessions there was huge improvement with Rufus' behavior. Highly recommend Cailin and her training skills along with the rest of the Copilot group.

Our foster dog, Enzo, has been transformed after just 1 month of drop off training with Copilot. Susy, Margaret, & the whole team are magical! They listen to the challenges your dog has and customize a plan to work on them. Susy has such a calm demeanor that both you & your dog will be able to relax to focus on new training activities. Additionally, she made so many suggestions to help integrate Enzo into daily house activities. Enzo went from walking like a sled dog to being able to walk on a loose leash several times a day. Training for a dog is always ongoing but if you want a huge head start you need copilot training. Enzo now has some essential skills that will help him navigate the world and hopefully find his forever home!

Margaret is amazing! She helped me understand how to better support my sensitive, anxious pup on walks and at home. We also took the Calm Co-pilot class, and had a blast! We've recommended Copilot to many friends and all have had great experiences.
Have done both in home private training and some classes with co pilot and would absolutely recommend them for anyone who needs a great dog trainer. Absolutely the best people to trust with your pet.

Absolute best! We have been working with Copilot for almost a year now . We have seen so much progress with our reactive rescue pup. We completed 2 classes and individual sessions with Margaret.  Margaret and her team are so helpful and accommodating, whether that’s sending me resources, answering questions! Margaret has emailed our vet to ensure the best care for him.  I love how many different classes they offer and how frequently they run! We will definitely continue to bring our dogs for years to come!

I've brought my very anxious dog to classes at Copilot and worked with some of their trainers. They love their work and love to get to know your dog! Your dog will get some personalized attention during class, which is different from training classes I've taken elsewhere. They have great class offerings that are very affordable. The trainers are very personable and caring. Highly recommend!
Love the trainers here! They make my stubborn beagle very comfortable and feel loved!
Exceptional facility with informed, caring staff

Would absolutely recommend Copilot!!! They were incredible about giving us the tools to help our pup, Biscuit, with her leash reactivity / big feelings. They helped us feel more confident about taking care of her needs. She loveddd going to class. Thank you all so much, especially Susy and Margaret.

Legitimately cannot say enough good things about the entire Copilot team. Jess and Margaret have been amazing helping with our dog’s reactivity, giving us the confidence to work with our dog and make her (and us!) more comfortable outside. We also took an adult dog class with Margaret and Susy for our other dog and she loved it so much, she would drag us to class every week! Every single member of the Copilot team has helped us on our dog training journey and they all do so with compassion, a huge amount of knowledge, and fun. Don’t wait — call Copilot today!
I don’t know what I would do without Copilot!!!! Margaret is the best. Been taking my dog here since she was a puppy. So many great options!

I cannot recommend this dog training facility enough. Our Irish Wolfhound puppy took the drop off training option and is so well behaved thanks to the copilot team. Margaret susy and team treat all dogs like their own and have become like family to our big bertha. They even helped us transition into regular daycare. If you get a new puppy and need training support and a personalized experience, this is the place for you!

I can't recommend CoPilot enough! We have done 4 weeks of day training and private sessions with Margaret to work on my dog's reactivity, and she has made amazing progress. Margaret is very knowledgeable, and my dog is literally obsessed with her! I love that my dog is learning in a way that is effective and kind using positive reinforcement. If you're looking for a trainer who truly cares and gets results, CoPilot is the best choice!

We had our first one on one session with Margaret on Monday and I'm thrilled. She took the time to talk with me about what we're looking to work on and was realistic about our expectations (I am the first to admit that I'm a slow learner) and I feel confident in our game plan moving forward.
My dog's biggest problem is that she's extremely outgoing, and inappropriate in greetings with people which is a stark difference from my last dog that was reactive to all people and other animals. I carry a lot of anxiety from having lived with such a reactive dog for 10+ years and Margaret was reassuring that I won't ruin my dog and that she has a genuinely good happy demeanor.
I highly recommend Margaret and Copilot to everyone

Margaret is so knowledgeable and amazing. The new spot is so cute! Their drop-off training program is incredible—they only accept FOUR dogs per day, so you know your pup is getting elite care and training. 10/10!!!

Loving my experience with the team at Copilot. We've taken puppy class and progressed along to adult dog classes and our dog is doing beautifully. We've also done some puppy play classes and love the supervision from the team. EXCELLENT experience! Will continue to take other classes as they are offered. Great addition to the neighborhood dog community.

Ronnie is great!  We did the Puppy 1 class and she is an awesome instructor.  We also had a personal hiccup (had to push back to the next session) and she was very understanding and easy to work with.  My pup Donnie loved his time at Copilot!

Margaret is the best dog trainer I’ve ever had (and I’ve had many). She’s incredibly enthusiastic and welcoming. She’s extremely patient and adjusts training effortlessly if something doesn’t seem to work for my dog Finch, who is a rescue. I saw her do this with all the other dogs in the class as well, so that every dog had a chance to try Every skill in his or her own way. She’s also super super kind and encouraging to the humans who are trying so hard to teach our doggies. Her new space is bright and clean, and she even
Want to provided a mat for Finch to sit on because I didn’t have one that I brought with me. Honestly, I’d give her 10 stars if I could don’t hesitate to sign up for classes or playgroups or workshops with Margaret @Copilot!!

The only bad thing about Copilot is that I didn't find them sooner. I cannot recommend them enough. Margaret has been such a pleasure to work with and our dogs absolutely adore her. Every session is fun and engaging and helps us come up with ways to manage different challenges with our little pack. I'm looking forward to attending group classes at their new location but the in-house training has been life changing!
We found Copilot as recommended by a friend. We rescued Gus in late August from Georgia and wanted to start training right away to get him used to city life. …

I recently started the adult dog basics class, and it's absolutely fantastic! Our trainer is Jess, and she is kind & funny - keeps the class light hearted while making sure you & your dog know the plan/goals. When I had a question about …

I contacted Copilot as soon as I got my bullmastiff puppy because I was drawn to their positive reinforcement approach. We did private classes at first and they helped so much with foundational skills for him (and me!). I've also attended …

We had such a great experience working with Ronnie and Copilot Dog Training. We were looking for help with our puppy who was showing signs of separation anxiety and Margaret recommended we work with Ronnie to address some of the issues we …

We had the best experience with Copilot! Margaret is kind and super knowledgeable, and makes training fun and easy. We were able to understand our dog’s needs and with the simplest tricks our walks are now easier and even more enjoyable. …

Cannot recommend Copilot training enough! I reached out to Margaret for a private session to navigate welcoming a new baby into our home. She was so great at giving me all the tips to set both of my dogs up for success and gave me the confidence that we needed to manage our new family dynamic. 10/10!

Such a positive training experience! The Copilot team is knowledgeable, solution oriented, and non judgemental!! We've learned so much from working with them both in private lessons and group classes. Truly a game changer for us and our pup. Thank you Copilot!!
